description: This file contains configuration loading routines for a Flask-based backend, reading environment variables to set app configuration such as database URI, JWT secret key, CORS origins, and auto-creation behavior.

methods.name: None load_config(app)
methods.description: Loads environment variables into the Flask application's config object, setting database, JWT, CORS, and auto-create options.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_database_url_from_env()
methods.description: Constructs and retrieves the database URL based on environment variables, either directly from DATABASE_URL or from POSTGRES_* variables if DATABASE_URL is absent.
